Companion animal travel notice: keep your documents and care steps ready

Travelers using Aurelia Skyways should read this notice before moving between services with a companion animal, so the Companion Animal Travel Desk can support you smoothly.

At the Companion Animal Travel Desk, we coordinate care from booking through pickup, and we work with the ground team to move carriers carefully between areas. Our staff share practical instructions with crews, including handling preferences and any travel comfort notes you have provided, so your animal is treated with consistent, attentive care.

If you are concerned about a lost crate or a delivery delay, please act promptly and retain any identification papers you received at check-in. <<FACT F118>> 

For travelers needing the pet relief area, please follow the signposts on the ground level and use the correct access method. <<FACT F016>> 

On busy service days, capacity at the skyport can affect waiting comfort for pets. <<FACT F012>> 

If you have questions, please visit the desk at any time before scheduled pickup. Sara Fischer and Emil Cohen, and any other travelers passing through with Milolet or another companion animal, are welcome to ask for clarification about carrier handling, connecting service timing, or what to expect during transfer.
